t: This is a sculpture at Marylebone Lower House, part of Westminster Community School, in the City of Westminster. It was made by Leonard Manasseh, a British architect who lived from 1916 to 2017. Manasseh is best known for the National Motor Museum at Beaulieu, which he co-designed with Ian Baker. So it's interesting to find a work by him here at a school. I don't have further detail about the sculpture, so have a look at it for yourself and see what it suggests to you.
